title: Restore Integrity Failure Queue
dataSources: Breach alerts (`hibp:alert`), password age snapshots (`passwordage:account`), backup restore tests (`backuprestore:test`), and DNS leak checks (`dnsleak:check`).
app: Personal security telemetry from Have I Been Pwned, password-age exports, backup restore drills, and DNS leak checks sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=backuprestore:test
| stats count(eval(integrity_ok="false")) as failures count as tests by backup_set
| sort 0 - failures
description: Ranks backup setss by restore integrity failures.
value: Integrity failures deserve a clean queue because they turn a comforting green backup badge into false confidence.
implementation: Send restore integrity failures events to `index=personal` and keep `backup_set` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of restore integrity failures by backup sets.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds which backup setss stand out most for restore integrity failures.
